submodule.addDescription: Add a dependency inside this repository. Its entry will be staged for review.
submodule.path: Checkout path · relative to this repository
submodule.name: Configuration name · optional
submodule.branchHelp: Leave empty to use the remote's default branch. Use . to follow the parent repository's branch.
submodule.addBranchHelp: Choose a named branch or leave empty for the remote default. To follow the parent branch, set . in Submodule settings after adding.
submodule.forceAddHelp: Allow ignored paths or reactivating an existing submodule Git directory.
submodule.duplicate: A submodule with this path or configuration name already exists.
submodule.editHelp: Changes remain in .gitmodules for review. URL changes are also synchronized locally.
submodule.deinitDescription: Remove the local checkout while keeping the project's submodule entry.
submodule.removeDescription: Remove the checkout and stage the submodule's deletion.
submodule.historyKept: The selected submodule's Git history is retained for recovery.
submodule.forceRemoveHelp: Delete checkout files even when they contain local changes or untracked work.
submodule.failed: The operation could not be completed. Review the operation error and reload before retrying.

bisect.title: Bisect
bisect.description: Find the commit that introduced a change.
bisect.actionFailed: The step could not be completed. Review the operation error; the current session has been reloaded.
bisect.firstParentHelp: Follow the first parent of merge commits, treating each merge as one change.
bisect.noCheckoutHelp: This session uses BISECT_HEAD without changing the worktree. Test that revision before classifying it.
bisect.skipHelp: Skip a revision that cannot be tested. Skipping may leave more than one possible result.
bisect.ambiguousHelp: Some candidates were skipped. Test one when possible, then mark its result.
bisect.returnTo: Return to {{revision}} when the session ends.
bisect.knownGood: Known good revisions · one per line
bisect.resetHelp: End the session and return to the original branch or detached revision. Stash or restore any tracked changes first.

branch.renameDescription: Rename {{name}} in this repository. Its commits, tracking configuration, and reflog are preserved.
branch.nameTaken: A local branch named {{name}} already exists.
branch.renameFailed: The branch could not be renamed. Review the operation error and retry.
branch.upstreamDescription: Choose the remote branch that {{name}} tracks for pull, push, and ahead/behind status.
branch.noRemoteBranches: No remote branches are available. Add a remote or fetch its branches, then reopen this dialog.
branch.upstreamFailed: The upstream could not be updated. Review the operation error and retry.

remote.editDescription: Change the address used to fetch from this remote. Save updates repository configuration without fetching.
remote.explicitPushUrl: Explicit push URL: {{url}}. This address is configured separately.
remote.saveFailed: The URL could not be saved. Review the operation error and retry.
remote.renameFailed: Could not rename this remote. Review the error and retry.
remote.pushUrlsHint: One URL per line. Git pushes to every configured URL. Leave empty to use the fetch URLs.
remote.inheritedPushHint: These addresses are defined in another configuration source. Edit that source to change them.
remote.pushSaveFailed: Could not save push URLs. Review the error or reload the configuration.

sidebar.keepRemoteBranches: Remote branches that track these are left in place.

sidebar.deleteRemoteBranchDescription: This permanently deletes {{name}} from the remote. Anyone still using it will need to recover the branch.
sidebar.deleteUnmergedDescription: {{name}} is not fully merged into the current branch. Deleting it drops commits that exist only on this branch.
sidebar.deleteTagDescription: This deletes the local tag {{name}}. Remote tags are left in place.
sidebar.deleteTagRemotesDescription: This deletes the local tag {{name}} and the tag on {{remotes}}.
sidebar.deleteRemoteDescription: This removes {{name}} and its remote-tracking branches from this repository.

dynamic.undoPushedDescription: “{{commit}}” is already on {{upstream}}. Undoing it here leaves the remote unchanged, so publishing again needs a force push.
dynamic.rebaseDescription: Replay commits from {{branch}} that are not in {{target}}.
dynamic.operationConflicts: {{title}} in progress{{progress}}. Resolve conflicts on Changes, then continue.
dynamic.interactiveDescription: Replay commits after {{target}}. Oldest is first. Squash and fixup fold a commit into the one above it.
dynamic.hardResetDescription: {{branch}} moves to {{target}} and every uncommitted change to tracked files is discarded. This cannot be undone.
dynamic.worktreeDescription: Checks out another branch in its own folder, sharing this repository's history.
dynamic.removeWorktreeDescription: Deletes the folder {{path}}. Its branch {{branch}} stays in this repository.

worktree.lockHelp: Prevents Git from pruning, moving or removing this worktree. File edits and commits remain available.
worktree.unlockHelp: Allows Git to prune, move or remove this worktree again.
worktree.moveHelp: Moves the folder and updates its Git connection. Uncommitted and untracked files are preserved.
worktree.repairHelp: Choose this worktree’s current folder after a manual move. Git repairs its connection without moving files.
worktree.repairAllHelp: Repairs connections to registered worktrees after the main repository moves.
worktree.failed: The operation could not be completed. Reload to inspect the current state.
worktree.moveUnavailable: Move an unlocked, available linked worktree from another worktree tab.
worktree.duplicateTabs: Both the old and destination folders are open. Close one tab before reconnecting to preserve the other tab’s state.
